summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to webhook.site
details: twilio-platform-async-data-fetch@99.99.99 declares a postinstall hook that runs index.js on every install. The script collects installer-side identifiers — package name (process.env.npm_package_name), hostname (os.hostname()), OS username (os.userInfo().username), and current working directory (process.cwd()) — and POSTs them as JSON to a hardcoded webhook.site endpoint (https://webhook.site/42ce0f0e-a0a0-41b5-b157-1c0f918e064f). The package name mimics a Twilio-scoped identifier and the version (99.99.99) is shaped to win dependency-confusion resolution against an internal package of the same name. Installation triggers an outbound beacon to an attacker-controlled collector with no legitimate functionality present in the package.
